# R2.20 — Extension-trust producers — scanners, LegCrossing, hygiene consumers

Ticket `docs/tickets/126_R2.20__extension-trust-producers.md`
(seq 126). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.19` (PR #126);
ADR-0352. Offline-only: every leg is `fixture`-verified — source
listings are caller-supplied `ScanEntry` rows, no filesystem walk
or endpoint inventory exists at this slice (CC5).

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.23-2 · BL-28 · R-2.8.5 · R-2.12.2 ·
CC1 · CC2 · CC5 · CC10.

## What landed

**`DeclaredSource` scanners produce `ExtensionRef`s (ADR-0352
D1–D2).** `lifecycle::scan_declared_sources(&[(DeclaredSource,
Vec<ScanEntry>)], &TrustView, MergePolicy)` folds caller-supplied
listings into refs — the `discover(sources, policy)` enumeration
half the S4.14a emitters left open. The live `allowed_sources`
union gates each *source* (`SourceNotAllowed`, fail-open only when
no live policy declares the member); filesystem members are
contained under the declared roots (`directory_scan` relative
under `root`, `instruction_files` under a declared `roots` entry —
`..`/absolute/foreign paths refuse `ScanDenied`, a new typed
`RegistryError`); every produced locator is credential-free; and
`merge_policy` resolves `(name, kind)` collisions — `exact_only`
refuses `NameCollision`, never silent last-wins. Produced refs
carry `locator.scheme = source.kind_str()` so the assembly's
`ExtUndeclaredSource` coverage check sees them by construction;
pinning stays resolve's job. `MergePolicy`'s home moved to
`hh_registry::extension` (the grammar re-exports — one enum, one
owner, CC1).

**`LegCrossing`/L3 at runtime (D3).**
`extension::lift_declared_claims(manifest)` lifts the claim
members (`allowed_tools`/`allowed-tools`/`allowedTools`,
`tool_annotations`/`annotations`, `permissions`/
`permission-manifest`/`requests`, `claims`) into
`trust.declared_claims` — the only legal home — inside
`resolve_extension`/`install_completed`, before the record
exists; a pin/grant-shaped claim value refuses `LegCrossing`
there (a hostile manifest can no longer mint a record
registration validation would later reject). `enforce_leg_boundaries`
re-runs L1–L3 plus the new L2 conferral check — a delegate-origin
or delegate-`installed_by` record carrying conferred `grants` is a
`LegCrossing` — at resolve, install, seal and activate.

**`TextHygieneReport` consumers (D4).** The declared-but-unwired
`TrustRootPolicy.scanner_policy` member is now the consumption
rule: `advisory` mints + surfaces (the pre-R2.20 posture and the
empty-policy default); `quarantine` lands a `flagged`/
`unavailable` report `TrustStatus::Quarantined` with the durable
`security.extension.quarantined` row naming `scanner_flagged`/
`scanner_unavailable`; `deny` refuses `ScanDenied` — nothing
mints. `TrustView::scanner_policy` projects the strictest posture
over the live policy set (`deny > quarantine > advisory`); an
unrecognised declared spelling fails closed `Deny`. `unavailable`
is never `clean`.

**The `resolved`/`quarantined`/`sealed`/`loaded` producers
(D5).** `resolve_extension`/`install_completed` mint
`security.extension.resolved` (+ `quarantined` on the verdict)
onto `ResolveReport.events`/`InstallOutcome.events`;
`seal_extension` gates `status = resolved`, the pinned locator
(L4) and `grants ⊆ authority_cap` (`AuthorityWidening`) before
minting `security.extension.sealed{extension_id,
trust_snapshot_ref}`; `activate_extension` gates
`{resolved, sealed}` (`revoked` → `Revoked`, `quarantined` →
typed refusal), re-runs `check_surface` for `surface_pin`ned
records under `drift_policy` (`notify` loads with the changed/
added tools suppressed; `pause_surface`/`terminate` mint no
`loaded` row — the drift row + decision are the evidence), and
mints `security.extension.loaded{extension_id, isolation,
pin_check, content + resolved (the pin attestation — Rule O),
surface_check, checked_by}` with an honest `surface_check`
(`clean`/`drifted`/`not_supplied`/`no_surface_pin` — never a
check that did not run). Every declared `security.extension.*`
class now has a producer. Payloads ride the result structs — the
`check_surface` convention: the caller's fenced writer appends
(CC2, durable-before-visible).

**Boundary (D6).** `lab.extension.{scan, seal, activate}` join
the `lab.extension.*` family (group `L`, `json`/`json` — `ops.rs`
+ regen, CC7); `resolve`/`install` accept `payload` (the bytes
the hygiene scan reads) + `manifest` (the claim source) and
return `events[]` beside the landed members.

  `sealed`/`loaded`), scanners, the L2/L3 runtime checks and the
  hygiene consumers all landed; the cell's remaining members are
  spec-staged halves riding their own stage assignment (the
  Stage-4 install-procedure trail; the Stage-2 review/UI
  surfacing leg).
- `BL-28` → **closed** — every declared `security.extension.*`
  class emits from a real lifecycle path.
- none opened.
- `R-2.8.5` → **MET** in the coverage matrix (the C1 slice is
  complete incl. the producer legs).
